title: Create or adopt crates/apricity-daw: gzipped XML writer, file references, cucumber runner
description:
## Intent

Ground work: one crate that writes the DAW's documents, shared by the three export initiatives (set export apricitus-6edba8, sidecars apricitus-d7746d, and this one). Check the board first: if a sibling initiative has already created it, extend it instead and say so in a comment.

## Scope

- `crates/apricity-daw` (library crate, workspace member): `doc.rs` (an XML element builder with stable attribute order, gzip writing with a fixed header time so output is byte-identical run to run), `fileref.rs` (a sample file reference: absolute and relative paths from the output file, per `design/daw-presets.md`), error type with a location field.
- No audio dependencies, so it builds for `wasm32-wasip1` (the web app may call it later).
- Add the crate to `Cargo.toml` workspace members and to the README layout table.
- Cucumber runner skeleton `crates/apricity-daw/tests/daw_conformance.rs` (`harness = false`), reading `features/daw/*.feature`, with a helper that writes tiny synthetic WAVs and manifests into a temp folder (reuse the sidecar initiative's generator, apricitus-2831a6, if it exists).

## Out of scope

Any rack, clip or set content (later tasks).

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo build -p apricity-daw --target wasm32-wasip1
```

## Release

`chore(<this task id>): add the apricity-daw crate`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by M0. Coordinate with apricitus-6edba8 and apricitus-d7746d (comment on both initiatives when created).
